in_marathi.name: Anujit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anujit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anujit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'anu' meaning 'near' and 'jit' meaning 'victory'. It signifies a peaceful warrior who is always near victory and success in life.

in_bengali.name: Anujit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Peaceful warrior
